However, its origin story of being derived from a term that was considered inauspicious, and its subsequent transformation to mean ‘golden’, embodies a classic theme in Hindu philosophy where seemingly negative circumstances can be turned around into positive outcomes. This may serve as a reminder of the tenacious human spirit's ability to rise above adversity and to transform challenges into opportunities.
